raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 17
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misread a Discogs credit (“Written-By – Hank Williams”) on a Norah Jones single that also included “Cold, Cold Heart” (a Hank Williams song) and incorrectly assumed it applied to “Turn Me On.” They then directed giving the final answer as Hank Williams, despite authoritative sources (and the song’s history) attributing “Turn Me On” to John D. Loudermilk. This error stemmed from attributing a release-level credit to the wrong track and from claiming a release page context that hadn’t been properly opened/verified.
